menu-sea.png.prompt: Create an original cinematic ocean background image for a psychological mystery lighthouse game's main menu. 16:9 landscape, full bleed, no letters, no UI, no logo, no people, no boat visible, no buildings. A photographic shot low over the dark teal open sea from a gently moving boat, realistically detailed rolling wind ripples and a little off-white foam at the bottom right. A low remote dark forested island on the horizon, mostly on the right half, soft layered grey overcast sky with a restrained pale warm glow through clouds toward the upper right. Horizon at 36% down from the top, water fills most of the frame. The left third has low contrast dark sea and subdued sky, providing natural quiet negative space for a title and four menu choices. Mood: an ordinary coastal summer afternoon made quietly uncanny, nostalgic analog film footage, very fine restrained grain, cool desaturated jade water, silver highlights, deep charcoal shadows. Beautiful nuanced film color grade and believable water detail, natural lens and perspective. No overt horror symbols, no red yet (red glitch effect will be programmed separately), no sun disc, no stars, no fantasy lighthouse, no text, no borders. Aim for the authenticity of handheld sea footage in a Japanese coastal mystery ending sequence, but an entirely new original composition.

menu-simulation.mp4.shader: menu-sea.js samples actual video frames. Rare red palette changes, horizontal tears and chromatic separation remain; image-water displacement removed. Native Unity integration will use a live scene camera after HTML approval.

mayak-wordmark-v2.svg: Redrawn on 2026-11-14 and approved by the owner for Unity. Original hand-authored Cyrillic vector paths, not font outlines: broad wedge-serif letters, three tentacles continuing the M, a readable Ya bowl/diagonal and lighthouse stem with transparent windows. One flat ivory fill; no masks, filters, embedded fonts or external images. Active in menu.html and copied byte-for-byte to Lighthouse/Assets/Resources/KeeperMenu/mayak-wordmark.svg with the existing GUID. Explicit 760x220 viewport and preserveViewport retain the approved proportions in Unity.
